0.why: Saw.cpp:318 takes getChannels() on this input and Saw.cpp:328 reads channel c with getPolyVoltage; Saw.cpp:329 clamps the knob-plus-input sum to -4 to 5, so a negative voltage lowers the pitch
Saw.cpp:319 sets this output's channel count from the pitch input

comment: The waveform comes from two 24-point and 19-point breakpoint tables resampled into 2048-point lookup tables at Saw.cpp:258 to :266. The crossover frequencies 20 and 100 are at Saw.cpp:247. The output is multiplied by 1.666 at Saw.cpp:375 to bring its peaks near ±5V. The module runs at four times the sample rate and decimates back (Saw.cpp:24).
